Actor Rajpal Yadav Joins Public Queue for Lalbaugcha Raja Darshan

Actor Rajpal Yadav was observed waiting in the regular queue for darshan at Lalbaugcha Raja, chanting "Ganpati Bappa Morya" and greeting devotees. This action has drawn praise on social media, particularly in light of an ongoing case involving a ₹9 crore cheque bounce. Yadav was seen amidst the public, foregoing VIP treatment.
